prerequisites: Node.js 16 and npm. `package.json` and `.nvmrc` ask for Node 16. The README and CI still name Node 12.
The `.env.development` file with the development database credentials. The README says to get it from the `#admin_panel_chat` channel in the Greenstand Slack.

steps.title: Install the dependencies
steps.text: At this commit, a plain `npm ci` on Node 16 fails with `ERESOLVE could not resolve` (a peer dependency conflict between `@loopback/rest-explorer` and `@loopback/core`). The `--legacy-peer-deps` flag skips that check.

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.text: These are the CI checks. The tests need no database: 38 pass and 42 are skipped. Use `npm run test:ci`, because `npm test` starts Jest in watch mode.

steps.title: Add the configuration file
steps.text: Copy the `.env.development` file from Slack to the root of the repo. It sets `DATABASE_URL`. Without it, the server tries a database on `localhost:5432`.

steps.title: Start the server
steps.text: `npm start` builds the app, then serves it on http://localhost:3000. The `/api` routes return HTTP 401 until you log in, and the login needs the database.
